RP provides pace data in race cards. Not ingested. Front runner identification is root cause of most drain course failures.
Track-adjusted speed figures available from RP. Local derivation possible from sigma win patterns.
JTCD tables built but course-specific trainer win rate at specific venues not fully exposed to scorer.
Going captured but interaction with specific course drainage/camber not modelled. Cheltenham soft vs Flat soft are different.
Field size present in sigma but pace dynamic modelling not done. Small fields at Ludlow/Perth need different pace assumptions.
Static course profiles exist (this script). Could be encoded as binary feature for stamina-finish adjustment.
Distance present but optimal distance for horse at specific course not computed.
Passport has course history. Course experience count (runs at this venue) not used as feature.
Some courses heavily seasonal (Galway festival, Royal Ascot form). Seasonal adjustment not modelled.

s8_candidate_rules.name: BEVERLEY_MIDPRICE_WATCH
s8_candidate_rules.description: Flag Beverley races where winner_sp in 4-12 range and front_runner_flag absent
s8_candidate_rules.derived_from: S4 Beverley deep dive — mid_priced_won dominant miss reason
s8_candidate_rules.promotion_gate: n>=30 Beverley wins with rule applied, operator review required

s8_candidate_rules.name: SHARP_TRACK_PACE_WATCH
s8_candidate_rules.description: At sharp-turn tracks (Beverley, Chester, Catterick, Ripon, Thirsk): down-weight picks without pace flag
s8_candidate_rules.derived_from: S6 matrix — sharp track high mp_miss_rate

s8_candidate_rules.name: IRISH_TRACK_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR
s8_candidate_rules.description: For Irish tracks with n<20 in VELO: apply confidence floor, avoid A-tier classification
s8_candidate_rules.derived_from: S2 drain audit — Down Royal, Kilbeggan, Wexford, Clonmel all thin samples
s8_candidate_rules.promotion_gate: Pending Irish handler profile enrichment, n>=30 per venue

s8_candidate_rules.name: AW_SURFACE_PACE_ADJUSTMENT
s8_candidate_rules.description: For AW tracks (Tapeta, Poly, Fibresand): flag front-runner type more aggressively
s8_candidate_rules.derived_from: S6 matrix — AW tracks high front_runner_bias
s8_candidate_rules.promotion_gate: Backtest across AW corpus, operator review

s8_candidate_rules.name: UPHILL_FINISH_STAMINA_GATE
s8_candidate_rules.description: At uphill finish tracks (Beverley, Pontefract, Bath, Hamilton, Brighton, Salisbury): require stamina indicator present
s8_candidate_rules.derived_from: S7 feature gap — uphill_finish_stamp not in scorer
s8_candidate_rules.promotion_gate: Feature must be built and backtested first

s8_candidate_rules.name: DRAW_BIAS_KNOWN_TRACK_FLAG
s8_candidate_rules.description: At draw-bias-known tracks (Chester, Catterick, Ripon, Beverley 5f): suppress picks without draw data
s8_candidate_rules.derived_from: S7 feature gap — draw_bias feature absent
s8_candidate_rules.promotion_gate: Draw feature must be built and validated first

s8_candidate_rules.name: MID_PRICE_BAND_6_10_WATCH
s8_candidate_rules.description: 6-10 band is highest volume mid-price miss zone — monitor for systematic pick suppression opportunity
s8_candidate_rules.promotion_gate: Operator review after n>=200 in band, no model change without review

s8_candidate_rules.name: WORCESTER_EDGE_DEFEND
